citation: Mihačević, Borislav. 2022. "Boredom That Wishes Not To Be." Diametros 19(72): 26–43. doi:10.33392/diam.1744.
thesis: Heidegger's account of boredom in The Fundamental Concepts of Metaphysics involves a real 'sublimation' or transgression beyond the phenomenon's own descriptive limits, but the cause is not (per Svendsen) his privileging of the ontological question of the meaning of Being over the ontic; it is his failure to distinguish the truth of Being from the meaning/sense of Being. Because meaning and truth of Being are, for Heidegger, the same, the binding compulsion proper only to truth is illegitimately transferred onto meaning, which is properly non-binding and freely made or withheld.

sections.title: 1. Introduction (pp.26-29)
sections.summary: Pathos/paschein and thaumazein as the arche of ancient philosophizing vs. anxiety as the arche of Heidegger's fundamental ontology; profound boredom occupies the structural position anxiety occupies in Being and Time; survey of skeptical secondary voices (Ciocan, Elpidorou & Freeman, Svendsen, Gibbs) with qualified agreement/disagreement on each.

sections.title: 2. Preliminary considerations of metaphysics (pp.29-31)
sections.summary: The three Novalis-derived considerations framing the 1929/30 course prior to the boredom analysis proper: world (homesickness), finitude, individuation (solitude).

sections.title: 3. The awakening of attunement (pp.31-36)
sections.summary: The demand to let boredom 'be awake' rather than making it conscious; the becoming-bored/being-bored distinction; compressed recapitulation of the first form (station), second form (dinner party/Mitsein), third form ('it is boring for one'); closing turn to Das Man, technological rationality, and the contemporary refusal of boredom.

sections.title: 4. Conclusion (pp.36-41)
sections.summary: The three metaphysical questions (world, finitude, individuation) reprised through profound boredom; two further 'hidden' questions (freedom, truth) derived from FCM's animal-poverty/logos/aletheia excursus; critique of Elpidorou & Freeman's uniform lack-of-meaning/altered-time thesis; the truth-vs-meaning diagnosis; closing citation of Jean-Luc Nancy.

constructs.label: profound/deep boredom (FCM 3rd form)
constructs.treatment: central, sustained; site of the truth/meaning diagnosis

constructs.label: being-bored-with (2nd form)
constructs.treatment: sustained; read via Mitsein; sole locus of genuine loss of personal meaning

constructs.label: situational vs. trait/state boredom
constructs.treatment: terminological borrowing from Elpidorou & Freeman's state/trait labels

constructs.label: monotony/meaninglessness
constructs.treatment: central interpretive stake of the conclusion

constructs.label: temporality of boredom (time-drag)
constructs.treatment: extended, revisionary; proposes nunc stans / noeseos noesis over ecstatic repetition

constructs.label: flow / engagement (contrast pole)
constructs.treatment: oblique, via Gelassenheit vs. calculative thinking

readings.claim: Compresses the station/waiting example and the being-held-in-limbo / being-left-empty pair as the baseline, least situation-independent form.
Compresses the dinner-party example, reads it through Being and Time's Mitsein, and treats it as more profound/indeterminate than the first form.

Faithfully recaps 'it is boring for one' and the indifference of beings as a whole, but contests a linear/ecstatic-repetition reading of the form's altered temporality, proposing nunc stans / noeseos noesis instead.

Conclusion's turn to Das Man, technological rationality, and the contemporary refusal of boredom parallels FCM's diagnosis of profound boredom as the fundamental attunement of contemporary Dasein, though §§37-38 are not cited by number.

concepts.gloss: Suffering/being-affected as the root sense of pathos, distinguished from 'passion' or 'feeling'; the arche of ancient philosophizing via thaumazein.
The driving-away of boredom that drives time on; the access route into the first two forms.
Being-left-empty and being-held-in-limbo, the two structural moments carried across all three forms.
Being-with; used to frame the second form's boredom as arising despite full social participation.
Truth as unconcealment/showing (apophainesthai); the unifying answer to the manifold senses of being; central to the paper's truth/meaning distinction.
Non-willing, meditative thinking/releasement characterizing profound boredom, opposed to calculative planning.
The author's proposed non-linear temporal model for the third form's altered time-sense, replacing an ecstatic-repetition reading.
The paper's central distinction: truth is binding/compelling; meaning/sense is freely made or withheld. Their conflation is diagnosed as the source of Heidegger's sublimation of boredom.

interlocutors.name: Ciocan, Cristian
interlocutors.stance: qualified agreement — credits the tracing of continuities between FCM and Being and Time, but judges the authentic/inauthentic gap 'bridged but not closed'

interlocutors.name: Svendsen, Lars
interlocutors.stance: contested — agrees boredom involves loss of meaning, disputes Svendsen's causal attribution (meaning-of-Being vs. truth-of-Being) and rejects his 'no Being as such' conclusion

interlocutors.name: Elpidorou, Andreas & Freeman, Lauren
interlocutors.stance: partially contested — agrees profound boredom shares structure with the other forms, disputes the uniform lack-of-meaning/altered-time claim across all three forms

interlocutors.name: Gibbs, P.
interlocutors.stance: cited approvingly on boredom's difficulty of recognition as internally/externally caused

interlocutors.name: Slaby, Jan
interlocutors.stance: cited approvingly on moods as existential orientations and Mitsein-structure of the second form

interlocutors.name: Boss, Medard
interlocutors.stance: cited on time 'standing' rather than flowing

interlocutors.name: Arendt, Hannah
interlocutors.stance: cited on anxiety/corporeality and on technology's means-ends framing

interlocutors.name: MacIntyre, Alasdair
interlocutors.stance: cited in footnote against restricting the hermeneutical 'as'-structure to humans alone

interlocutors.name: Nancy, Jean-Luc
interlocutors.stance: closing citation on thinking as always concerned with sense

tensions.axis: profound boredom is boredom <-> profound boredom is a distinct existential mood
tensions.position: Stakes a middle position: profound boredom cannot be an entirely alien form since it shares the structural pair (Leergelassenheit/Hingehaltenheit) with the other two forms, but it is 'boredom that wishes not to be boredom.'

tensions.axis: uniform vs. differentiated loss-of-meaning across the three forms
tensions.position: Rejects the uniform reading (Svendsen; Elpidorou & Freeman): only the second form is genuine loss of personal meaning; the first form only suspends it; the third negates personal but not meaning-as-such.

tensions.axis: ontic/ontological confusion (Svendsen) <-> truth/meaning conflation (Mihačević's own diagnosis)
tensions.position: The paper's core original claim: relocates the cause of Heidegger's boredom-sublimation from Svendsen's ontic/ontological account to a truth/meaning conflation internal to Heidegger's own conception of Being.
